confidence_notes: Food and beer estimates use a current Siena price index; cocktail (about 1.5 times draft beer) and wine (about 1.1 times) are less directly observed. Lodging is a holistic July-season estimate. The RBA page retrieved displayed 2026-07-10 as its latest observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Siena city-level prices; lodging is modeled on central Tuscan historic tourist towns with July seasonality.
